cases.prompt: Create a vault note with obsidian-cli and verify it.
cases.expected_behavior: Selects the CLI sub-recipe, resolves the vault and note path, and reads back the exact result.

cases.prompt: Which Obsidian command should I use for the official app CLI?
cases.expected_behavior: Distinguishes the Obsidian.app obsidian binary from the Yakitrak obsidian-cli binary and uses their safe probes.
assertions: Does not treat their command surfaces as interchangeable.

cases.prompt: Decide where this personal note belongs in my vault.
cases.expected_behavior: Reports that personal taxonomy belongs to the composing knowledge-management policy owner.
assertions: Does not choose a personal taxonomy.
